name: Tmux Peek
description: Watch, message and drive your Claude Code agent teammates from Orca's sidebar. macOS and Linux; needs tmux and Claude Code's tmux teammate mode.

cover.alt: Tmux Peek in Orca's right sidebar: four Claude Code teammates working live in a two-by-two grid, with a message bar below.

screenshots.alt: Orca with a Claude lead chat on the left and Tmux Peek on the right: four agent teammates in a grid, one of them working.
One teammate maximized inside the Tmux Peek panel, outlined in green because keys typed now go straight to it.
A narrower sidebar: the four teammates redraw to fit their smaller panes.
